name: West Norriton Township Summer Day Camp
street_address: Marshall Street Elementary School, 1525 West Marshall Street
description_short: Seven week township day camp at Marshall Street Elementary School for children 5 to 13 who have finished kindergarten. Campers do arts and crafts, daily sports and weekly guest presentations, with optional day trips; camp meets Monday to Thursday only.

sessions.name: Summer Day Camp (7 weeks, Monday to Thursday)

notes: 2026: June 22 to August 6, 8:45 am to 3 pm Monday to Thursday, no camp Fridays. Fee is the total for all 7 weeks. Non-resident: $550 one child, $1,050 two children, $525 each additional child. Resident (proof required): $450 one child, $850 two, $425 each additional. Day trips are optional and paid separately; trip prices are not on the page. Registration for 2026 is closed.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Township Summer Camp page: 2026 dates June 22 to August 6, Monday to Thursday, ages 5 to 13, Marshall Street Elementary School, resident and non-resident 7 week fees; price shown is the non-resident rate for one child.
